rightsRule: Use watch.vote federal candidate and race pages only to corroborate FEC candidacy records, office sought, filing identifiers, and to discover downstream official FEC or campaign-source leads. Do not approve or reuse watch.vote-hosted imagery as a candidate portrait unless item-level candidate identity, provenance, and an explicit reusable license, documented candidate-supplied status with a narrow editorial-identification basis, explicit permission, or another supported reuse basis are independently established. Treat any asset labeled 'Portrait not verified' as ineligible for candidate-photo approval. Reject initials avatars, generic record graphics, logos, seals, social-share images, placeholders, and other non-candidate imagery.
